name: SimplyInsured
desc:
Employer Benefits Account Coordinator | $16/hr unlicensed, $17/hr licensed + $625 quarterly bonus | Inbound, No Sales Expectations
Company: SimplyInsured
Industry: Insurance / Employee Benefits Technology
What Your Day Will Look Like:
 You'd be helping small business owners get their employees set up with health insurance, start to finish. That means guiding new groups through onboarding, working with customers on their annual renewal, and reaching out by phone, text, and email to keep things moving and solve problems as they come up. You'd keep detailed notes in Salesforce so nothing falls through the cracks, and you'd work closely with internal teams to make sure the whole process feels smooth on the customer's end. It's relationship-driven support work with a real insurance component behind it, not just general customer service.
assessment: Expect a typing test and generalized assessment
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
 Education Minimum: Not specified in the posting
Required Experience: 1 to 2 years of experience in a customer service or sales role
Preferred Experience: Previous experience with Salesforce
Required Skills:
A Life and Health Insurance license, or the ability to obtain one within 3 months of starting
Positive, optimistic personality with strong customer empathy
Ability to multitask and work high volume across multiple channels
Fantastic oral and written communication skills
Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
A participant who already holds a Life and Health insurance license, or is motivated to earn one within the first 3 months
Someone with 1 to 2 years of customer service or sales experience who wants to move into insurance
Someone who is naturally upbeat, empathetic, and enjoys helping small business owners solve real problems
Someone comfortable multitasking across phone, text, email, and Salesforce all in the same day
Not a Good Fit for
Anyone who cannot commit to obtaining a Life and Health license within 3 months if they don't already have one
Anyone under 1 year of customer service or sales experience
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Life and Health insurance license
Client onboarding
Employee benefits
Customer service
Salesforce
Insurance enrollment
Renewal management
Multichannel communication
Small business support
Relationship management
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
Application
Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you
If the assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen
If the phone screen passes, expect a final interview
Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3 to 15 days on average.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell us about your experience in customer service or sales and how it prepared you for this role.
Are you currently licensed in Life and Health insurance, or are you willing to obtain that license within 3 months?
Walk us through how you'd help a small business owner through their annual benefits renewal.
How do you stay organized when managing a high volume of customer interactions across phone, text, and email?
What excites you about helping small businesses navigate health insurance?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $16 per hour unlicensed, $17 per hour once licensed, plus a quarterly performance bonus opportunity of $625
Shift: Flexible schedule options between 7am and 6pm CST, Monday through Friday
Benefits: Generous stock option packages, "take what you need" time off, 100% Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for employees and dependents, and a 401k
Equipment Provided: Not specified in the posting, and no internet requirement is listed either. Confirm both during the recruiter screen
Felony Friendly?: Not stated
Drug Test: Not stated
Notes: This is a great match for your insurance licensing pathway participants, since the role explicitly allows someone to start unlicensed and earn their Life and Health license within 3 months, with a built-in pay increase once licensed. The 100% covered health benefits and generous time off policy are strong selling points. One small thing to flag, the posting title says Employer Benefits Account Coordinator but refers to the role internally as Client Outreach Manager, so it's worth double checking with the participant or recruiter which title shows up during the actual application.
Career Pathway: Employer Benefits Account Coordinator → Senior Account Coordinator → Client Success Manager or Team Lead
